newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells stake in timber firm for $1.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells stake in timber firm for $1.1 mln.

text.p: Bulgaria's Privatisation Agency said on Monday it had sold 24.4 percent of Lesoplast timber processing firm to Austria-based joint stock company Welde for $1.1 million.
Under the deal 30 percent should be paid in cash on the day of signing the contract and the remainder in long-term government securities within 45 days.

Another 67 percent of the company will be offered for sale under Bulgaria's mass voucher privatisation, 6.6 percent will be offered to employees in non-voting shares and 2 percent will be put aside to meet property claims by pre-communist owners.
Vienna-based Welde trades in timber and timber planes.

Lesoplast, based in the central town of Troyan, produces hard and polished timber planes, plywood and packing. Its 1996 turnover was 600 million levs. Over 60 percent of its production was exported. -- Sofia Newsroom +359-2 981 4145
